contract.definition:
def valid(text):
    """题面：1 <= len(columnTitle) <= 7，仅由大写英文组成，范围在 ["A", "FXSHRXW"] 内（FXSHRXW = 2147483647）。"""
    if not text.endswith('\n'): return False
    L = text[:-1].split('\n')
    if len(L) != 1 or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z]{1,7}', L[0]): return False
    v = 0
    for c in L[0]: v = v * 26 + ord(c) - 64
    return v <= 2147483647

contract.definition:
def valid(text):
    """题面契约：第一行 S 仅含小写字母，1<=|S|<=10^6；第二行 P 为与 S 等长的 01 串。"""
    import re
    m = re.fullmatch(r'([a-z]+)\n([01]+)\n', text)
    return bool(m) and len(m.group(1)) == len(m.group(2)) <= 10 ** 6

"""逐题注入错误，由小域独立计算检出。"""
import importlib.util,inspect,json
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('o','/tmp/gmyhf_batch3_oracles.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
changes=[(27933,'boxes','stack.sort(reverse=True)','stack.sort()','重排方向错误'),(28678,'collatz','else "*3+1"','else "*3+0"','奇数步骤输出格式错误'),(28681,'scholarship','scores[j][0],-j','scores[j][1],-j','同分错按数学排序'),(28699,'fruits','frequencies=list(Counter(parts[2+n:]).values())','frequencies=[1]*len(Counter(parts[2+n:]))','忽略重复水果次数'),(28748,'pku','counts[x] for x in unique','1 for x in unique','忽略相同数字的签数权重'),(28776,'king','product//y','product//x','奖励错误除以左手数'),(28780,'change','front<<coin','front<<(coin+1)','硬币面值偏一'),(29334,'excel','ord(c)-64','ord(c)-65','A从0计数'),(29622,'mst','answer+=cost','answer+=cost+1','边权被加一'),(29647,'party','total-maxflow(graph,s,t)','total','忽略直接上下司冲突'),(29662,'islands','if j<n*m and cells[j]','if j<n*m and cells[j] and j!=i+m','不合并上下相邻陆地'),(29739,'cipher','low<high','low<=high','允许禁止位置完整匹配'),(29741,'neural','power=l-2','power=l-1','多算一个中间城市层'),(29853,'bridge','max(b)-d<=x<=min(b)+d','min(b)-d<=x<=max(b)+d','可行交集误作并集'),(29940,'health','max(1,needed-delta)','max(0,needed-delta)','允许血量归零'),(29945,'collatz','else "*3+1"','else "*3+0"','奇数步骤输出格式错误'),(29946,'delete_digits','end=len(s)-left+1','end=len(s)-left','可选窗口漏掉最右位置'),(30061,'meeting','Counter(range(n))-counts','Counter(range(n-1))-counts','漏查最后一位学生'),(30062,'subsequences','x<=y','x<y','拒绝相邻相等'),(30085,'gifts','x+y<=w','x+y<w','拒绝价格和恰等上限')]
rows=[]
for n,name,old,new,reason in changes:
 original=getattr(m,name);src=inspect.getsource(original);assert old in src,(n,old);exec(compile(src.replace(old,new),'<mutation>','exec'),m.__dict__)
 try:m.selfcheck()
 except (AssertionError,ValueError,IndexError):killed=True
 else:killed=False
 setattr(m,name,original);assert killed,(n,name);rows.append({'global_number':n,'function':name,'defect':reason,'replace_before':old,'replace_after':new,'killed':True});print(n,'变异检出',flush=True)
Path('/tmp/gmyhf-batch3-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
